digest.component_or_area: store auto-push and event payload security
propositions: A rejected tickets-branch auto-push succeeds locally and reports success to the caller while the push is actually rejected by GitHub push protection, leaving commits diverged and invisible to other agents
The rejection reason (git stderr, policy decline markers) is captured but discarded, so the caller sees only a bare retry count rather than the underlying cause
Rejection warnings are pull-only and never re-announced on subsequent writes, so a multi-hour backlog of unpushed commits remains silent unless manually detected
Ticket event comment payloads are never scanned for secrets on write, leaving credentials exposed despite code review gates on push
The fix must preserve the best-effort contract (never fail the caller, always return None) while making rejections visible by naming the reason and the unpushed backlog count
